todays_goal: Repair two precision gaps from Day 17 Math and advance into equivalent expressions.

lessons.subject: mathematics
lessons.lesson_title: Equivalent Expressions and the Distributive Property
lessons.previous_learning: Day 17 was strong overall. Repair signed terms and the equals-sign distinction before advancing.
lessons.course_context: Repair precision gaps, then apply the distributive property and check equivalent expressions.
learning_objectives: Distinguish equations from expressions by the equals sign.
lessons.why_it_matters: Equivalent expressions support later algebra, modeling, and equation solving.

vocabulary.definition: different-looking expressions with the same value
multiply a factor by every term inside parentheses
a number or expression multiplied by another

lessons.written_instruction: Atticus: repair the exact precision issues first. Then distribute a factor to every term inside parentheses and check whether expressions are equivalent.

worked_examples.title: Signed terms
worked_examples.explanation: The subtraction sign belongs with the second term.

lessons.voice_prompt: Speak directly to Atticus using short questions. Teach before practice. Use the whiteboard for different examples only. Require every factor to multiply every term. Never give an assigned final answer.
lessons.teacher_notes: Brief accuracy retrieval; expressions unit is primary.
